response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals and 14+ years of experience, he is fundamentally misaligned for this role. His expertise is primarily in web/full-stack development (Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript) with only 6 months of C++ exposure in 2014-2015. Critically, he lacks any demonstrated experience in industrial automation, IoT platforms, secure development lifecycle practices, IEC 62443 standards, or the networking/multi-threading/message-broker architectures central to the position. His background (Computer Science + Photography degrees) also doesn't align with the preferred engineering discipline requirements.
strengths: 14+ years of diverse software development experience across multiple domains and technology stacks demonstrating adaptability
Strong software craftsmanship principles including TDD, CI/CD, code quality, and active mentoring of other engineers
Proven architectural thinking and technical documentation skills with ability to design systems and lead technical discussions
concerns: Severe C++ expertise gap: only 6 months of recent exposure in 2014-2015; past decade focused on Node.js/TypeScript web development rather than systems programming
Zero demonstrated experience with industrial automation, IoT platforms, message brokers, MQTT protocols, or industrial communication standards (Modbus, IEC 61850, OPC UA)
No evidence of secure development lifecycle practices, IEC 62443 industrial cybersecurity standards, or secure coding expertise in systems/embedded contexts

key_factors.factor: Missing security standards and SDL experience
